description:
About the job

Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist




Remote (Latin America-based; CST time zone preferred; English-fluent)

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Director of Marketing

Direct reports: None

Company size: ~65 employees




About Tricura:




Tricura Insurance Group is a next-generation, tech-enabled insurance and risk management company transforming how healthcare organizations protect, manage, and grow their operations.




We're a global, remote-first team headquartered in New York, combining deep insurance expertise with modern technology to build smarter, faster, and more transparent solutions for the healthcare industry.




We're a team across North and South America, building products and internal systems that leverage AI, automation, and data to fundamentally improve how our business operates.




If you're excited by combining data, technology, and experimentation to solve complex growth challenges—and want to help build the marketing engine of a fast-growing company—we'd love to meet you.




About the Role:




We're looking for a highly analytical Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist to build and optimize the data-driven side of our marketing engine.




This is not a brand, creative, content, or social media role. We already have a strong team focused on brand positioning, design, messaging, content, and events.




Your role is to build the systems and campaigns that get that content in front of the right people, at the right time—and determine whether it's actually influencing business outcomes.




You'll own performance marketing across channels such as Google and LinkedIn, develop account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns, build reliable marketing attribution and analytics, optimize conversion throughout the funnel, and continuously experiment with new ways to influence revenue.




Importantly, our challenge isn't simply generating more leads. We already have significant opportunity volume across our insurance and technology businesses. A major opportunity for this role is helping us convert existing demand more effectively by reaching known accounts and decision-makers with the right messages throughout their buying journey.




This is a highly quantitative individual contributor role. Success will be measured by campaign efficiency, funnel conversion, account engagement, attribution accuracy, pipeline impact, and marketing's contribution to revenue—not by the volume of content produced.




If you naturally gravitate toward dashboards, experiments, conversion rates, attribution, and figuring out why one campaign performs better than another, you'll thrive here.




What You'll Do:




1. Own Performance Marketing

Manage and optimize Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns
Develop targeting, audience segmentation, retargeting, and bidding strategies
Continuously optimize campaigns based on conversion and business performance
Test new audiences, channels, messages, calls to action, and campaign structures
Manage marketing spend with a strong focus on measurable business impact and ROI




2. Build Account-Based Marketing Programs

Develop and execute targeted ABM campaigns for high-value accounts and opportunities
Use known buying signals, account data, and decision timelines to determine when and how to engage prospects
Build campaigns that strengthen awareness, trust, and differentiation throughout the buying journey
Develop strategies for reaching multiple decision-makers within target organizations
Partner with Sales, Underwriting, and Marketing to identify high-value accounts and opportunities where marketing can influence conversion




3. Build Marketing Analytics & Attribution

Own marketing analytics, dashboards, and KPI reporting
Build reliable attribution between marketing activity, pipeline progression, and revenue
Track campaign performance beyond clicks and impressions to understand actual business impact
Analyze CAC, conversion rates, account engagement, pipeline influence, and campaign ROI
Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities through data
Give leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where we should invest more




4. Improve Funnel Conversion

Analyze our commercial funnels to identify opportunities for marketing to improve conversion
Design campaigns aimed at moving existing opportunities through the funnel—not simply generating additional leads
Improve landing page conversion rates through continuous experimentation
Execute A/B tests across ads, landing pages, email campaigns, audiences, and calls to action
Develop campaigns around different stages of the buying journey
Partner with commercial teams to understand where and when marketing can most effectively influence buying decisions




5. Build Marketing Automation & Infrastructure

Develop and optimize HubSpot workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and marketing automation
Improve how marketing data flows between campaigns, HubSpot, analytics platforms, and commercial teams
Build scalable processes for campaign tracking and reporting
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve marketing efficiency and execution speed
Continuously improve the infrastructure behind our digital marketing programs




6. Identify New Growth Opportunities

Identify new acquisition, engagement, and conversion channels
Monitor search behavior, competitor activity, and audience signals to uncover opportunities
Support paid search and SEO strategy around high-intent keywords
Develop and test hypotheses about new ways marketing can influence revenue
Help determine which marketing channels and strategies Tricura should scale over time




Who We're Looking For:




4+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, or another highly quantitative B2B marketing role
Strong B2B marketing experience, ideally with complex products or services and longer sales cycles
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Ads
Advanced hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads

title: Senior Growth Copywriter
description:
About the job

🚨 Petsmont is hiring: Senior Growth Copywriter & Angle Research Lead




Full-time remote




Compensation: $5,500-$7,500/month USD




This is not a normal copywriting role.




We’re looking for a sharp DTC growth copywriter who can help us find new product angles, write high-converting landing page copy, and turn customer research into profitable tests.




Petsmont is a fast-growing pet wellness brand. We’re looking for someone who can help us uncover what pet parents actually care about, translate those insights into strong positioning, and build landing page concepts that can scale through paid traffic.




This role is for someone who:

→ Has 5+ years of DTC/ecommerce copywriting, funnel, or growth experience

→ Has written landing pages, advertorials, prelanders, product pages, or funnel copy for paid traffic

→ Knows how to turn customer research into angles, hooks, headlines, and page structures

→ Understands direct response, conversion copywriting, and performance marketing

→ Can think beyond “nice copy” and write for relevance, clicks, scroll depth, and conversion

→ Has enough design intuition to structure landing pages clearly, even if they are not a designer

→ Is comfortable using AI to speed up research, ideation, and landing page development without producing generic AI copy

→ Can work with landing page builders, heatmaps, analytics, and rapid iteration

→ Has strong English and can write with emotional precision

→ Wants a full-time dedicated role, not freelance client work on the side




You will work on:

→ New product angle research

→ Customer review and voice-of-customer analysis

→ Landing page copy and structure

→ Headline and hook development

→ Paid social angle concepts

→ Funnel and page iteration

→ Research-backed product and marketing insights

→ Working with our designer and growth team to turn ideas into live tests




We are not looking for:

✗ Agencies

✗ Fractional consultants

✗ Freelancers juggling multiple clients

✗ Generic AI copywriters

✗ SEO blog writers

✗ Brand-only copywriters

✗ People who only write emails or social captions

✗ People who need every brief handed to them




The right person is part copywriter, part researcher, part funnel strategist, part performance marketer.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to help build a repeatable growth system inside an 8-figure DTC brand.

title: TikTok Shop - Creator Marketing & Operations Specialist - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a marketer with an analytical mind and creative to work on our creator ecosystem. You will be a strategic and executing part of the go-to-market of the program. Focusing on analyzing channels and communities to understand what creators need at every stage of their journey. You will also design and produce the marketing pieces that accelerate their growth, grow our own channels, and maintain a close relationship with the community. You will work directly with the Creator Marketing Lead and with stakeholders in Brand Marketing, Operations, Partner Management and regional teams. 

Responsibilities: 
- Co-design the affiliate program marketing strategy
- Identify growth levers, communication gaps and opportunities per segment 
- Translate channel and community performance findings into creative briefs
- Build message frameworks by creator journey stage - from awareness to discovery - and land them on concrete pieces with measurable results
- Produce the marketing pieces that execute the strategy with creative quality and branded voice.
- Design and run marketing experiments with clear metrics before scaling.
- Coordinate with freelancers, agencies and the internal design/video team to ensure timely deliverables 
- Manage the monthly editorial calendar of campaigns and communication, aligned to the program's milestones, e-commerce seasons (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, etc.) and the creator's journey.
- Adapt global/regional materials to the context of the Mexican market

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in growth marketing, content marketing, brand, digital agency, creator/influencer marketing, CRM or similar roles 
- Hands on experience in production + data, focused on social networks and creators.
- Storytelling and copywriting.
- Knowledge of TikTok and content creators.
- Ability to produce content yourself when needed
- Experience with creative tools.
- Intermediate or above English

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in creator economy, MCN, affiliate programs, influencer agency or e-commerce brand.
- Background in growth marketing, performance marketing or CRM 
- Experience operating branded accounts on TikTok.
- Experience with SQL, Looker, Table or equivalents 
- Experience with email marketing / CRM platforms

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Have experience in B2B marketing, ideally in tech or SaaS.

Events (webinars, field events, partner activations)
Email marketing / CRM (HubSpot is a plus)

Makes marketing feel human, practical, and useful, not corporate.

About the job

Account Executive - Mexico (Based in Mexico City)




Hey! We're CONECTA, and we're looking for someone based in Mexico City to be our person on the ground for Mexico.




Who we are | CONECTA connects luxury hotels, resorts, and DMCs with Latin America's top travel advisors - Brazil first, and now expanding hard into Mexico. We've been doing this for years, and if there's one thing we believe in, it's our tagline: Connecting People & Experiences. That's not just marketing - it's genuinely how we work. We build real relationships, and those relationships turn into unforgettable trips for real people.




The gig | You'd be our first dedicated Account Executive for Mexico - based in CDMX, visiting agencies and tour operators, running trainings, showing up at events, and building the relationships that make our portfolio one of choices for Mexican travel advisors. That footprint grows to other Mexican cities too, and you'll travel together alone and with the rest of our team for roadshows and events along the way.




We work in bleisure - literally business + leisure - and honestly, that's the best part of the job. Yes, we need results: bookings, relationships, a healthy pipeline, numbers that move. But we also believe you should enjoy the ride. Fam trips to five-star resorts, events in incredible destinations, real perks that come with representing a luxury travel portfolio — take advantage of it. We work hard and we play hard, and we want someone who gets that balance.




What you'll actually do

Visit and build relationships with Mexico's top travel agencies, tour operators, and consortia - in person, regularly.
Run portfolio trainings so advisors know our hotels, resorts, and DMCs inside and out.
Show up at industry events, trade shows, and roadshows - representing CONECTA in Mexico (and traveling with/without the team as coverage grows).
Hunt down and develop new relationships with agencies and operators we haven't reached yet.
Keep your pipeline honest - every visit, quote, and follow-up logged with a next step, using our CRM and procedures.
Follow our playbook: the same speech, templates, and reporting that the whole sales team uses and keeps updated together, so wherever in Latin America someone talks to CONECTA, it sounds like CONECTA.
Team up with our Sales, Marketing, and Concierge crew in Brazil for the job!




What we need from you

You live in Mexico City, and you're up for traveling - within and outside Mexico.
3+ years selling into the luxury travel trade (hotels, resorts, DMCs, hotel representation) - you know this world.
A network of your own among Mexico's luxury agencies and consortia? Huge plus.
Native-level Spanish. Fluent-to-advanced English is a must. Portuguese? Awesome if you speak it, but not required at all.
Self-driven and organized, comfortable being measured on real numbers - but also a team player who works within our shared process, not around it.
The kind of person who's excited to be first on the ground in a new market.




What's in it for you

STARTING IN JANUARY 2027
Founding the Mexico market for an already respected luxury travel representation company.
Direct mentorship from our Managing Director and Sales leadership.
A front-row seat to the world's best luxury hotels, resorts, and DMCs - and the trips that come with it.
2k+ Monthly USD fee (independent contractor engagement) commensurate with experience, plus performance-based incentives.




Sound like you? Send your CV - in English - plus a quick note about your experience with the Mexican luxury travel trade to naldo@conecta.one, or apply straight through this posting.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Trailhead

Trailhead is Salesforce's free online learning platform and the front door to the Salesforce ecosystem. It empowers anyone to build in-demand skills across AI, Agentforce, CRM, data, and business fundamentals — and helps organizations re-skill their workforce for the agentic era. The Trailhead Content team generates ideas, writes and edits content, develops hands-on challenges, and publishes and maintains the learning content that makes all of this possible. We believe content should be accessible, educational, relevant, and enjoyable. This is your chance to be part of it.

Role Description

As a Content Strategist, Emerging Products, you define the learning strategy for Salesforce's newest product innovations before they reach market. You embed early with our product and PPM teams to understand new product architectures, identify learner needs, and shape content plans ahead of general availability.

Salesforce ships new products fast, and learners need a way to build real skills the moment those products land. This role makes sure that learning is ready on day one, accurate, and built around what people actually need to do their jobs. As AI tools increasingly draw on Trailhead content to answer questions, getting that content right matters more than ever, for the human learning directly and for everything built on top of it.

Your Impact

Role

Success in this role is measured by your ability to ensure Trailhead has a structured, trustworthy content strategy in place at every emerging product launch:


Own content strategy for emerging Salesforce products, starting with Headless 360, so Trailhead has day-one learning content at each launch.
Partner with product and engineering teams before GA to build real product depth and shape content plans early.
Translate complex technical architectures into learner-centered strategies for multiple audiences: admins, developers, architects, and employees.
Build reusable frameworks and playbooks that cut time-to-publish as new products enter the portfolio.
Define the content structure and quality standards that let Trailhead serve as a trusted source for AI agents and MCP-driven experiences.
Use beta feedback, early adoption signals, and stakeholder input to validate direction and adjust as products evolve.

4+ years in content strategy, instructional design, or content development, in a technology or enterprise learning environment.
A track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, learner-centered content for multiple audiences.
Experience partnering with product or engineering teams to build content plans that track to product development cycles.
Strong cross-functional skills, with a history of building real relationships across product, PMM, and learning teams.

Experience using data and feedback to validate and iterate on content strategy.


What We Look For In Every Hire


Learner-first. You tie content programs to measurable outcomes and work with field and product teams to solve real skill gaps, not hypothetical ones.
A clear communicator. Your writing is direct and jargon-free. You respect people's time.
Collaborative by default: you seek out other perspectives, share work early, and give feedback that actually helps.
High ownership. You own outcomes, flag blockers before they become fires, and take bold positions when the evidence backs you, even when that's the harder road.
Curious about AI. You test AI tools for content work and design strategies that prepare learners for human-agent workflows.

About the job

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

You own Product & Lifecycle Growth marketing for Everand and Fable, end to end. Everand is our audiobook and ebook subscription product; Fable is our book-tracking and discovery community. Both are built for people who love books and reading. You'll set the positioning, plan the launches, build and ship the campaigns yourself, and measure what they move.

This is a senior individual contributor role built for a self-starter who is energized by both the strategy and the build. You'll go from a launch narrative one day to building the campaign in Iterable the next, and you'll go hands-on whenever that's the fastest path to impact.

What You'll Do


Own positioning and messaging for Everand and Fable across features, launches, and seasonal moments, tailored to each brand's audience and stage.
Lead go-to-market for new features and product updates, from concept through launch and adoption.
Build and ship the campaigns yourself across email, push, and in-app in Iterable, including audience segmentation and technical setup.
Partner with the dedicated lifecycle team to align launch moments with the always-on program, and own member and brand communications across those moments.
Partner with Product and Brand to shape the roadmap and keep messaging consistent with each brand's voice.
Define the metrics, set targets, instrument tracking before launch, and report on impact.
Test and iterate on messaging, timing, and targeting, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
Contribute to growth across the funnel, partnering with Product and Brand.


What You'll Bring


6+ years in growth, lifecycle, or product marketing in a subscription or consumer product business, with hands-on campaign execution.
A track record of owning GTM strategy and shipping the execution yourself.
Hands-on experience building campaigns in a marketing automation platform (Iterable or similar).
Strong writing skills, with the ability to own brand voice and turn it into copy that ships.
Comfort self-serving in data: you can read a query or dashboard and use it to make decisions.
A founder/owner mindset, you move on a priority without waiting for a fully specified brief, and a genuine love of books and reading.

Are you looking to build something greater than yourself? Do you want to work alongside some of the most dynamic people in the industry? If so, Slack just might be the place for you.

Onboarding Specialists are the first technical partners for our newest Slack Premier and Signature customers. JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico, Instituto Tecnológico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey, Universidad de Guanajuato, Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana, etc. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive the adoption of JoVE products at universities and colleges in Mexico. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever and strives to succeed and grow with the company. If you're eager to advance your career in sales and grow with a dynamic team, this is the perfect opportunity for you.


Responsibilities


Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed new business targets.
Present the product online and in-person, to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians.
Proactively build & maintain pipeline through active outreach via emails, calls and in-person meetings.
Analyze trends and make data-driven decisions based on priorities in your work.
Work effectively with Marketing and Customer Success to deliver on sales targets, renewals, team projects and campaigns.
Attend trade shows and participate in other marketing activities.


Requirements


A Bachelor's degree.
Fluent in Spanish and English.
3+ years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
Proven ability to acquire new customers and grow existing accounts in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in-person and online.
Experienced with Salesforce or similar platforms.
Self-motivated, results-oriented, and willing to learn new skills.
Willingness to travel at least 5 days per month is required.


Benefits


A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales.
You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!


Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The Food Execution Team at DiDi is looking for a high-performing Intern Analyst to help drive sustainable growth and operational health for our top restaurants across Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Peru. In this role, you won't just execute strategies—you will help reshape how we work.

We are looking for a tech-savvy, strategic thinker who can leverage Python, automation, and AI integrations to optimize our day-to-day operations, support our field agents, and deliver top-tier market experiences for our clients. If you want to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and cutting-edge technical execution, this is your path to success.

Role Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Strategic Reporting


Insight Generation: Extract, manipulate, and analyze complex datasets to deliver actionable business insights and influence team decision-making.
KPI Management: Monitor, report, and maintain daily business KPIs, designing dashboards that track the operational health of our top regional restaurants.
Strategic Collaboration: Act as the analytical bridge to the Strategy Team, translating high-level goals into tactical, data-driven execution plans.
Experimentation: Constantly generate operational knowledge and validate process improvements through structured A/B testing.



Automation & AI Integration


Process Automation: Use Python to automate repetitive manual workflows, streamline data pipelines, and improve the efficiency of our support agents.
AI Solutions: Identify opportunities to integrate AI tools and frameworks into current processes to scale impact, improve response times, and optimize process standardization.
Process Engineering: Carry out root-cause analysis on operational bottlenecks and propose automated solutions to mitigate them.



In this role, you'll be...

What will you be doing?

Strategic Planning & Operational Execution


End-to-End Operational Ownership: Plan, analyze, and execute key operational activities, taking responsibility for the entire lifecycle of strategic initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams and the Sales Team to align daily operational execution with high-level commercial goals.
Process Optimization: Carry out root-cause analysis on operational challenges, designing data-backed solutions to improve process efficiency and standardize team KPIs.



Advanced Reporting & Data Analytics


Insight Generation: Extract and interpret complex business data to deliver actionable insights, uncover growth opportunities, and directly influence team decision-making.
Strategic Proposals: Formulate and pitch high-level, data-driven proposals aimed at scaling business impact and driving sustainable growth.



Automation & Process Engineering


Workflow Automation: Utilize Python and SQL to build automated reporting frameworks, streamline manual workflows, and optimize data pipelines.
AI Integration: Identify, test, and propose opportunities to integrate AI tools and models to enhance operational efficiency and future-proof current processes.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Role Qualifications

The Successful Applicant:


Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Advanced Analytics & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Python (for data analysis and automation) and SQL (for data extraction). Familiarity with Claude Code CLI and R is a plus.
Core Tools: Advanced knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets (advanced formulas, pivot tables, complex data manipulation).
AI-Assisted Automation: Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code CLI or modern AI coding tools. You know how to use AI assistants through the command line to help write, debug, and automate Python scripts and basic data pipelines, moving beyond basic ChatGPT prompt engineering.
Mindset:
A strict KPI-driven and strategic mindset with a passion for problem-solving.
Highly self-motivated, proactive, and possesses a strong "owner attitude" to take challenges from ideation to execution.
Language Skills: Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to effectively collaborate with our international team.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

Employee Assistance Program

On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

Join a growing travel business where you can take ownership of the guest experience, learn the operational side of international travel, and potentially grow into sales and cruise booking responsibilities over time.

About the job

BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

The Coordinator, Creative Project Management will partner closely with Creative, Production, Editing, and Content Production teams to ensure the timely and efficient delivery of audiovisual assets aligned with digital publishing schedules, social media campaigns, premieres, and special events. This role will be responsible for coordinating both pre-production and post-production processes for marketing audiovisual content across the company’s brands and platforms.

The Coordinator, Creative Project Management Will Be Responsible For


Executing the production of audiovisual assets and overseeing project plans according to established strategies across Disney+, Studios, Lines of Business (LOBs), Marketing initiatives, and digital platforms.
Coordinating the production of creative assets, promotional materials, and supporting events, including the development of makelists, graphic toolkits, and the delivery of final materials.
Tracking project assets and ensuring compliance with technical requirements, quality standards, and delivery deadlines.
Managing version control, master files, and distribution materials.
Coordinating the final review and approval process for all deliverables.
Partnering with Creative and Editing teams to monitor progress and ensure projects remain on track.
Establishing and managing project priorities to meet business needs and deadlines.
Maintaining accurate project documentation, schedules, and status reports.
Identifying and recommending process improvements to increase efficiency and optimize workflows.
Providing flexibility and availability outside of regular business hours when required to support event coverage and key initiatives.


What we need from you to be part of this story:


Bachelor’s degree in Audiovisual Media, Film & Television Production, Advertising, Communications, Multimedia Design, or a related field.
+2 years of experience in project coordination, post-production, advertising, or a related creative environment.
Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced setting.
Self-confident, agile, proactive, organized, and highly committed to delivering results.
Positive attitude with the flexibility to adapt to changes, feedback, and evolving project requirements.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams and levels.
Creative mindset with the ability to contribute ideas and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken.


Additional Information

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas.

“You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Role Overview

The Head of DiDi studios will lead DiDi’s In-House Creative Agency, responsible for developing and delivering all marketing campaigns and design work across the app and multiple external channels. This role oversees a multidisciplinary team of 20+ creatives and designers distributed across different countries and manages relationships with external creative agencies and partners.

This leader is expected to operate at the intersection of business strategy and creativity, translating business needs, user insights, and growth priorities into impactful creative solutions at scale.

In this role, you'll be...

Key Responsibilities

Creative & Strategic Leadership


Own the creative vision and output for DiDi’s marketing campaigns and brand experiences across all businesses and channels.
Lead the team into translating business objectives, growth priorities, and user insights into strong creative territories, concepts, and executions.
Act as a strategic partner to marketing ensuring creativity serves clear brand and business outcomes.
Elevate the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of creative work across markets.



Team Leadership & Development


Lead, inspire, and develop a diverse in-house team of creatives across multiple countries.
Build a high-performance, collaborative culture with clear standards for quality, speed, and accountability.
Set clear priorities, processes, and ways of working to enable efficient execution at scale.
Coach and grow creative leaders within the team, ensuring long-term capability building.



In-House Agency Operations and external agency management


Define and continuously evolve the operating model of DiDi studios, balancing speed, quality, and scalability and finding the right partners to compliment required capabilities. 
Ensure strong collaboration with DiDi Studios, marketing teams, and other internal stakeholders.
Manage external creative agencies and production partners when needed.
Ensure external partners complement internal capabilities and meet DiDi’s creative and business standards.
Own the creative output, integration, and performance of all external collaborations.



Creative Excellence & Innovation


Continuously raise the creative bar, pushing for bold, effective, and culturally relevant ideas.
Stay up to date with creative, design, and technology trends to evolve DiDi’s creative capabilities.
Promote a test-and-learn mindset, using insights and performance data to refine creative work.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Qualifications & Experience


10+ years of experience in creative leadership roles within agencies, in-house studios, or a combination of both.
Proven experience leading large, multidisciplinary creative teams in regional environments.
Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect business needs to creative opportunities.
Experience managing external agencies and complex creative ecosystems.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments is a strong plus.



What Success Looks Like


Creative work consistently drives business impact and user value.
The in-house agency operates as a trusted strategic partner to the business.
Teams are engaged, developed, and delivering high-quality work at scale.
DiDi’s creative output is distinctive, effective, and culturally relevant across markets.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

title: Creative Strategist
skills: Growth into Leadership: Your path is to take over day-to-day leadership as the Lead Creative Strategist.

Producing 15–20 detailed briefs and iterations per week to maintain a constant stream of fresh content for paid social channels.
Crafting UGC scripts and hooks specifically designed to drive performance metrics on Meta and TikTok.

description:
About the job

Are you a data-driven storyteller who knows how to turn insights into content that captures attention and drives results? As a Creative Strategist, you will lead the creative direction for high-performing campaigns, using data and analytics to guide decisions while staying true to authentic, creator-led content.




In this role, you will act as the key driver of growth, translating performance metrics into actionable creative strategies, testing new approaches, and shaping content that turns browsers into buyers. Your work will directly influence how the brand scales toward its next major milestones.




This is a fully remote, full-time role working 9am–5pm EST.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Growth into Leadership: Your path is to take over day-to-day leadership as the Lead Creative Strategist.
Massive Creative Scale: You will be responsible for a high-volume testing environment, launching 15–20 new briefs or iterations weekly.
Performance Rewards: Compensation includes a fixed base salary supplemented by performance-based bonuses for winning ad creatives.
Full Remote Autonomy: Work from anywhere as long as you are aligned with the EST time zone.




WHAT YOU’RE GETTING INTO

Producing 15–20 detailed briefs and iterations per week to maintain a constant stream of fresh content for paid social channels.
Crafting UGC scripts and hooks specifically designed to drive performance metrics on Meta and TikTok.
Directing video editors and collaborating with creator managers to ensure all raw content aligns with strategic creative briefs.
Partnering with the media buyer to analyze ad data, identifying winning patterns, and rapidly iterating on successful concepts.
Studying customer reviews, testimonials, and competitor behavior to uncover and exploit new marketing angles.
Leading morning kickoffs and concluding each day with documented wins and technical learnings to keep the creative team aligned.
Integrating AI tools like Claude and Higgsfield into the workflow to accelerate research, ideation, and script development.
Transitioning from day-to-day execution to overseeing high-level messaging and strategy as the brand scales.
Proactively identifying creative performance drops and developing new testing angles to maintain consistent revenue growth.
Working with design and media buying teams to review ad performance and optimize the entire customer journey.




WHO YOU ARE

You have 3+ years of experience in creative strategy, creative operations, or UGC production specifically for a skincare or beauty brand.
You have a proven track record of writing high-performing scripts and briefs that drive measurable sales and engagement.
You are highly proficient in analyzing paid social performance metrics to guide your creative iterations and strategy.
You are experienced in managing video editors and possess the attention to details.
You are proficient in or ready to master a creative stack that includes Notion, Foreplay, Kalodata, Claude, and Higgsfield.
You thrive in fast-paced environments, taking full ownership of your output without needing constant instruction.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Senior Specialist, you will plan, build, and optimize Paid Search and Shopping programs that drive efficient client growth. You’ll execute high-quality campaign management, translate performance data into clear actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, collaborate across Analytics, Creative, Product/Bliss Point, and Client Leadership, and mentor junior teammates. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Support the building and executing of Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, inventory, and ecommerce or lead gen realities; surface trade‑offs and options.
Communicate performance and recommendations clearly to internal partners and clients; contribute to QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Use platform capabilities (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), feed tools, and responsible automation (e.g., value‑based bidding, Performance Max) to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Apply Bliss Point insights (e.g., Always‑On Incrementality, Forecasting, Creative Insights) to inform optimizations; flag data quality issues and provide structured feedback to product teams.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; analyze trends; design basic A/B tests with success criteria; forecast expected impact where feasible.
Maintain data integrity (tagging, feeds, tracking); partner with Analytics to validate reads and address anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate deep Paid Search/Shopping craft with growing awareness of adjacent channels; connect measurement to growth; document playbooks and “how‑to” guides for repeatability.


Owner Mindset


Take initiative to eliminate spend and process waste; prioritize work against Rocks; follow through to impact and share learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 4–5 years executing Paid Search/Shopping with end‑to‑end ownership of builds, launches, pacing, and optimization; monthly budgets $75K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights, Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4, advanced Excel/Sheets; ability to build clear performance narratives and basic forecasts; design/run A/B tests.
Communication and collaboration: Clear client‑facing updates; cross‑functional teamwork; ability to mentor and delegate work to more junior team members.
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a plus.


KPIs 


Efficient growth: Improve efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue targets.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting spend; improve feed/tagging fidelity; reduce rework.
Product/AI usage: Pilot and adopt relevant platform/Bliss Point features with documented impact.

title: Motion Designer

Workflow Automation: Champion the use of AI-assisted tools to eliminate manual tasks. You will connect data feeds (Sheets/CSV) to creative templates to trigger high-volume renders with minimal manual intervention.

Asset Scaling & QA: Maintain rigorous organizational standards across massive asset libraries. You are the final line of defense, ensuring that every export—regardless of the quantity—meets our exact technical and brand specifications.
Strategic Creative Development: Design the foundational "Hero" motion assets that serve as the blueprint for our automated systems, ensuring they are built from the ground up for scalability.

Detail Obsessed: You are someone who naturally spots a 1-pixel misalignment or a slight tracking inconsistency across 100+ localized banners.
3–5 years of experience in an agency or fast-paced in-house creative team.
A portfolio demonstrating high-end motion work alongside examples of dynamic/programmatic creative projects.
Proven track record of managing "Creative at Scale" (localizing content for multiple regions or AB testing).
A "hacker" mindset—always looking for a way to automate a repetitive task.
An essential requirement is having advanced and conversational English.
description:
About the job

Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Semi-Senior Motion Designer who finds as much beauty in a perfectly organized project file as they do in a smooth animation.

In this role, your primary mission is to act as the architect of our visual output. You won’t just be creating videos; you will be building the engines that allow our global campaigns to live across dozens of languages and formats with surgical precision.

You are the bridge between high-end design and massive-scale execution. While you will develop original creative assets, your core focus is on the technical craft of localization, template architecture, and AI-driven automation using the Google ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities



Master Template Architecture: Design and "bulletproof" complex After Effects templates. You will ensure that layouts, typography, and timings adapt intelligently to varying text lengths and localized content via Expressions and Essential Graphics.
Precision Localization: Own the end-to-end technical rollout of global campaigns. You will ensure every regional variation is frame-perfect, managing the nuances of different languages and cultural formats with an obsessive eye for detail.
Workflow Automation: Champion the use of AI-assisted tools to eliminate manual tasks. You will connect data feeds (Sheets/CSV) to creative templates to trigger high-volume renders with minimal manual intervention.
Asset Scaling & QA: Maintain rigorous organizational standards across massive asset libraries. You are the final line of defense, ensuring that every export—regardless of the quantity—meets our exact technical and brand specifications.
Strategic Creative Development: Design the foundational "Hero" motion assets that serve as the blueprint for our automated systems, ensuring they are built from the ground up for scalability.



Your Technical Mindset



The Architect: You believe a project is only as good as its structure. You prioritize clean hierarchies, strict naming conventions, and scalable workflows.
The Logic Specialist: You have a deep command of After Effects Expressions and scripting, using them to solve layout challenges before they occur.
The Google Power-User: You are comfortable navigating Google Workspace, and leveraging Gemini/AI tools to optimize creative production.
Detail Obsessed: You are someone who naturally spots a 1-pixel misalignment or a slight tracking inconsistency across 100+ localized banners.



Experience & Qualifications



3–5 years of experience in an agency or fast-paced in-house creative team.
A portfolio demonstrating high-end motion work alongside examples of dynamic/programmatic creative projects.
Proven track record of managing "Creative at Scale" (localizing content for multiple regions or AB testing).
A "hacker" mindset—always looking for a way to automate a repetitive task.
An essential requirement is having advanced and conversational English.

By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long-term impact.

Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025), runner-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024). Additionally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

description:
About the job

About Skift

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, providing news, research, and events that power smarter decisions across the global travel industry. We bring together our community of subscribers, members, and event attendees who rely on Skift for clarity, insights, and connection in an ever-evolving industry.




Why This Role Matters

At Skift, our relationship with our audience is at the heart of everything we do. Subscribers, members, and event attendees rely on us not just for insight, but for a seamless, professional experience every time they interact with Skift.

The Customer Experience Associate plays a critical role in delivering on that promise. This role is often the first point of contact. The work you do directly impacts customer satisfaction, retention, and trust in the Skift brand. This is also a role with visibility and impact.




The Opportunity

We’re seeking a Customer Experience Associate to join our growing team. This entry-level position is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and building relationships with our audience across subscriptions, memberships, and events.

This role will be the front line of Skift’s customer experience — supporting users, resolving issues, and ensuring that every interaction with Skift is smooth, professional, and memorable.




Some of What You’ll Do

Customer Support: Manage the customer support inbox and provide timely, thoughtful responses to questions about subscriptions, billing, event access, and membership benefits.
Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve login, access, and account issues across Skift’s digital platforms.
Billing & Payments: Track and follow up on overdue payments, assist with invoicing and renewals, and ensure accurate billing records.
Engagement & Outreach: Call or email event attendees, new subscribers, and members to collect feedback, confirm details, and enhance their experience with Skift.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the subscriptions, events, and membership teams to ensure a seamless customer journey and share insights that improve retention and satisfaction.
Documentation & Process: Maintain up-to-date customer records and contribute to improving internal support processes and resources.




What You’ll Bring

1–3 years of experience in a customer support or customer-facing role
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and empathetic tone.
Proficiency with HubSpot or comparable CRM
Experience with Stripe (required)
Comfort with phone and email outreach; confident speaking with customers and solving problems live.
Attention to detail, follow-through, and strong organizational skills.
Ability to evaluate information, draw conclusions and multitask
Curiosity and enthusiasm for Skift’s mission and the travel and media industries.
Efficient cross-team communication and project management skills
Native-level or near-native English proficiency (written and spoken) is required due to the volume of written communication, documentation, and live collaboration in English




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company.
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence.
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits.




How We Work

Skift is a remote-first, globally distributed company. We work asynchronously, value clear communication, and rely on strong documentation and follow-through to stay aligned across time zones.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a great fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter through our application system. The cover letter is an opportunity to share why you’re interested in this role and how your experience aligns with our work—we value thoughtful applications.




Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and those from other underrepresented communities.




Here’s what you can expect next




If you apply and are selected to interview, a Skift team member will reach out to you to schedule a time to connect.

description:
About the job

Description

When you join Amazon as a Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.

Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. You will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential, As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations.

Key job responsibilities

Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing

Analyze and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts

Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture

Analyze performance and suggest process improvements to optimize work and improve customer service

Promote best practice and continuous process improvements across your team in areas like health and safety and productivity

Collaborate with other managers to standardize shift processes

A day in the life

You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritizing routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analyzing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About The Team

Subsameday, or SSD, handles ‘first and last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilize creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Basic Qualifications


 High school diploma
 Work a rotating, flexible schedule, including nights, overnights, weekends and holidays. Able to work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
 1+ years of leadership experience in a retail, distribution or similar environment experience
 Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish


Preferred Qualifications


 Speak, write, and read fluently in English

· Habilidad de comunicación escrita: Capacidad de conectar "de humano a humano" con productores sin usar scripts rígidos.

Será un plus si tienes:

· Experiencia en medios, producción audiovisual, agencias de contenido o prospección B2B.

· Familiaridad con flujos de trabajo de video/podcast.

· Manejo de Smartsheet o herramientas de seguimiento similares.




Detalles del puesto & Beneficios:

Atender y canalizar llamadas externas relacionadas con reservaciones una vez que se cierren las ventas y consultas de los restaurantes inscritos en la certificación AAA con la finalidad de poder brindar la atención al cliente externo que desea comprar la experiencia sin estar hospedado o que desee adquirir un night pass.

Promover entre los clientes internos las experiencias gastronómicas especiales, denominadas Fine dinning y las Cenas Románticas con el objetivo de incrementar las ventas y posicionamientos de las experiencias gastronómicas.

Mantener comunicación constante con la Gerencia de Alimentos y Bebidas/ Subdirección de Alimentos y Bebidas, reportando cualquier anomalía o queja que ponga en riesgo la operación o la experiencia del huésped.
Dar seguimiento a Dine Around solicitados por Grupos, Bodas y/o eventos especiales, que permiten asignar ofertas para vender más y así generar un ingreso adicional.

BDR — Business Development Representative

En Toku estamos construyendo el futuro de la gestión de cobros recurrentes en LatAm, y buscamos un/a BDR que quiera ser motor de ese crecimiento. Serás la primera línea comercial: quien abre la puerta a nuevas oportunidades de negocio, conecta con tomadores de decisión y construye el pipeline que impulsa a todo el equipo de ventas.

🔎Investigar y prospectar cuentas objetivo en mercados B2B.
